Footer.fonts: Fonts from <link>fonter.am</link>, all free for commercial use.

Meta.description: Make your guest list in minutes: import it from Excel, CSV or a photo, seat guests at tables and print a seating chart, a guest list or place cards — in classic and creative templates, with Armenian fonts, on paper of any size.

Home.metaTitle: Guest list and seating chart, ready to print
Home.heroSubtitle: Import the list from Excel or a single photo, drag guests to their tables, and print a seating chart, an entrance list or place cards on paper of any size.
Home.heroNote: No sign-up. Everything changes right on the sheet.

stats.kinds: ways to print: chart, list, cards

Home.featuresTitle: From a list to a printed sheet in minutes
Home.featuresSubtitle: No spreadsheets, no designer: what you see on screen is what gets printed.

import.title: Import from anywhere
import.text: Excel, CSV, pasted text or a photo of a handwritten list — AI reads the names and the tables.

arrange.title: Arrange by dragging
arrange.text: Move a guest to another table, arrange in columns or rows, or place any block freely on the sheet.

templates.title: Classic and creative
templates.text: Gilded frames, the Armenian eternity sign, pomegranates and apricots, carpet borders, khachkars, art deco, neon — every colour and font can be changed.

paper.title: Paper of any size
paper.text: From A5 to an A2 poster, Letter, portrait or landscape — or your own size in millimetres.

fonts.title: 40 Armenian fonts
fonts.text: GHEA Grapalat, Mardoto, Tumanyan handwriting, Vrdznagir and more; Russian and English names show correctly too.

print.title: Print on the spot
print.text: Download a PDF and print it on any printer: fonts embedded, sizes exact.

Home.stepsTitle: Three steps to a finished chart

list.title: Make the list
list.text: Type the names, paste them from Excel or photograph a handwritten list.

arrange.title: Arrange
arrange.text: Seat guests at tables, pick a template, paper and fonts.

print.title: Print
print.text: Download a PDF and print it: a chart, a list or place cards.

Home.templatesSubtitle: A wedding, a christening, a birthday or a company party: pick a style, change the rest on the sheet.
Home.finalTitle: Your guests will find their seats without asking

price.a: Making a list and downloading it as a PDF in the “Classic” template is free. The other templates will cost {price} per list — once, no subscription; payments are coming soon.

account.a: No. You can make, print and download without an account — the list is kept in this browser. Sign in with Google or email to keep it in your account and open it on any device.

photo.a: Take a photo of a printed or handwritten list (up to 5 photos at once). AI reads the names and, where they are written, the tables. You see the result and can correct it before importing.

print.a: Press “Download PDF” and print the file at home or at any print shop. The page size matches the paper you chose.

paper.q: What paper sizes can I print on?
paper.a: A5, A4, A3, A2, Letter or your own size (from 5 cm up to 1.19 m). On a larger sheet the text grows automatically.

languages.q: Can I write in Russian or English?
languages.a: Yes. Names can be in any language, and the site is available in Armenian, Russian and English.

hints.kind: Choose what you are making. You can change it at any step.

layout.gridHint: Blocks line up automatically. Drag a block onto another to swap their places, or a guest’s name to move them to another table.

layout.cardsHint: Cards sit edge to edge so one cut separates two. A tent card prints on both halves with a fold line.
layout.freeTips: Arrow keys move the selection 1 mm (5 mm with Shift). Hold Alt while dragging to turn snapping off.
